name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The '06' is the dispatch-table index (domain ID), confirmed from the per-event handler table at 0x51B91: the DATA xref is at 0x51ba9 = base 0x51b91 + 0x18, and 0x18/4 = idx 6; the 4-byte slot there reads 22 44 03 00 = 0x00034422 (self). 'ch2_reinforcement' matches the chapter-2 event (walkthrough: at the end of player turn 3 six bandit reinforcements appear from the top), and the body arms exactly 6 runtime-char slots (5..0xA). No Ghidra address residue in the name (0x34422 absent).
purpose: Chapter-2 reinforcement turn-event handler (dispatch idx 0x06 in the per-event handler table at 0x51B91): plays the turn-3 reinforcement cinematic and arms 6 enemy reinforcements with an AI behaviour pair.
logic_summary: Straight-line cinematic followed by one bounded loop. Pans camera to world (9,1), ~100ms hold; brackets a portrait-set-3 reload with data_fd2_chapter_init_phase_flag=1/0 so it is treated as an init-phase load; triggers cutscene event 0xD, ~200ms hold, shows dialog page 4 (fixed geometry); then for runtime-char slots i=5..0xA sets combat_aux_block[0xE]=0x1A and combat_aux_block[0xF]=0x0F (the AI behaviour pair for the 6 reinforcement enemies). No RNG, no return value consumed. event_arg is ignored. __CHK(0x2C) stack-probe prologue is compiler-injected.
